description.en: A simple cheesecake with a sour cream topping. The original card lists only the ingredients and the baking temperature and time.
description.he: עוגת גבינה פשוטה עם ציפוי שמנת חמוצה. הכרטיס המקורי מפרט רק את המרכיבים ואת טמפרטורת וזמן האפייה.

ingredients.he: 2 חבילות (226 גרם כל אחת) גבינת שמנת

ocrRawText:
Dmp. Cheesecake
3/4 c. milk
2 tsp vanilla
2 eggs
1 c. sugar
1/2 c. Bisq.
2-8 oz pkgs cream ch.

Topping -
1 c. sour cream
2 tbsp sugar
2 tsp vanilla

350° - 40-45 min.
rankingReason: Result A is more accurate and coherent as a cheesecake recipe. It correctly identifies 2 eggs from the OCR text, while Result B incorrectly lists 3 eggs (not in the raw text). Result A also properly captures 2 tsp vanilla for the main mixture and separately for the topping, maintaining ingredient consistency. Result A's instructions follow proper cheesecake methodology (beat cream cheese, add ingredients gradually, bake, then add topping). Result B has internal inconsistencies (lists 2 tbsp vanilla in ingredients but instruction mentions mixing with other ingredients in a way that doesn't align with proper cheesecake technique). Result A's OCR raw text alignment is more faithful to what was actually written.

notes.en: The original card gives only the ingredients, the oven temperature and the baking time. No mixing method is written on the scan.
notes.he: בכרטיס המקורי מופיעים רק המרכיבים, טמפרטורת התנור וזמן האפייה. לא כתובה בסריקה שיטת הכנה.
